# Well-Being, AI, and Measurement Lab (WAM Lab)

> The WAM Lab, directed by Dr. Louis Tay (William C. Byham Professor of Industrial-Organizational Psychology) at Purdue University, conducts interdisciplinary research at the intersection of well-being scholarship, advanced psychological measurement, data science, and AI conversational agents. Website: https://www.wam-lab.com

## Key facts
- Director: Louis Tay, Purdue University, Department of Psychological Sciences.
- Contact: stay@purdue.edu, (765) 494-0715.
- Focus areas: subjective and psychological well-being; character strengths and vocational interests; psychological measurement and methodology (IRT, latent class, multilevel modeling); data science, machine learning, and AI; AI conversational agents and human flourishing.
- Louis Tay is the creator of ExpiWell, a leading Experience Sampling (ESM) and Ecological Momentary Assessment (EMA) research platform.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.wam-lab.com/index.html): Lab overview, mission, and recent publications.
- [Research](https://www.wam-lab.com/research.html): Research areas — taxonomies, continuum specification, data science/ML/AI, measurement & methodology, and well-being.
- [People](https://www.wam-lab.com/people.html): Director, graduate students, postdocs, staff, alumni; also how to join the lab.
- [Publications](https://www.wam-lab.com/publications.html): Peer-reviewed publications with DOIs.
- [Resources](https://www.wam-lab.com/resources.html): Free validated psychological scales and methodological tools (SETPOINT, CABIN, CAPTION, CIT/BIT, HELPS, RAISE, ALI, Subjective Underemployment Scale, IRT measurement-equivalence guide), each with dimensions and downloadable instruments.
- [Talks](https://www.wam-lab.com/talks.html): Talks and webinars (with video) on well-being measurement, big data, ML bias, and experience sampling.
- [Books](https://www.wam-lab.com/books.html): Edited handbooks and volumes on positive psychology, well-being, the positive humanities, big data, and measurement.
- [EMA](https://www.wam-lab.com/ema.html): ExpiWell — the experience sampling (ESM) and ecological momentary assessment (EMA) platform created by Louis Tay.
